blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Я, право, ___ (казаться), засохну сегодня.
exercises.why: The second actor (if mentioned) is always in the Instrumental case with the preposition "с": *Я не хочу встречаться с этим человеком.* Note that without "-ся" the verb встречать — встретить is used with the direct object in the Accusative case: *Вчера я встретил моего друга.* but: *Мы встретились на улице.* We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups. Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся": *Я боюсь вашего брата.* — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 66–67.  ·  «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Всеволод Гаршин, «Attalea princeps».
exercises.context: The second actor (if mentioned) is always in the Instrumental case with the preposition "с": *Я не хочу встречаться с этим человеком.* Note that without "-ся" the verb встречать — встретить is used with the direct object in the Accusative case: *Вчера я…

exercises.q: И кроме всего этого, ___ (сказать) вам ещё, что вас не просят делать замечания.
exercises.why: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37. From Всеволод Гаршин, «Attalea princeps».
exercises.context: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37.

exercises.q: Крыша ___ (покрывать / покрываться) наметённым снегом.
exercises.why: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs. The suffix "-ся" with these verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another … Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся".» — DLI, Lesson 67. From Всеволод Гаршин, «Attalea princeps».
exercises.context: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs.…

exercises.q: ___ (поставить / положить / посадить / повесить) здесь что-нибудь новое.
exercises.why: The perfective aspect places the emphasis on the result of the action. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  «Phrases meaning direction are used to denote the place where something is put ("на" + Acc., "в" + Acc., etc.)» «Literally садиться means "to seat oneself". It implies movement to a "seat" and, therefore, answers the question "куда?"» — DLI, Lessons 42, 68. From Всеволод Гаршин, «Attalea princeps».
exercises.context: The perfective aspect places the emphasis on the result of the action.

exercises.q: Ей теперь стало ещё ___ (тяжёлый), хотя и до этого случая было очень тяжело.
exercises.why: «The comparative degree of Russian adjectives is formed by adding "-ее" (sometimes shortened to "-ей") to the stem of the adjective.» — DLI, Lesson 80. From Всеволод Гаршин, «Attalea princeps».
exercises.context: «The comparative degree of Russian adjectives is formed by adding "-ее" (sometimes shortened to "-ей") to the stem of the adjective.» — DLI, Lesson 80.

exercises.q: Расти ___ (далёкий) было некуда.
exercises.why: The comparative degree of Russian adjectives is formed by adding "-ее" (sometimes shortened to "-ей") to the stem of the adjective: новый — новее; красивый — красивее. In both English and Russian adjectives and adverbs have three forms, which are called degrees: positive, comparative, superlative — good, better, best; fast, faster, fastest. This comparative form is the same for all genders and the plural. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80, 82.  ·  «Memorize the following irregular comparatives»: рано — раньше, поздно — позже, редко — реже, часто — чаще, близко — ближе, далеко — дальше, много — больше, мало — меньше, хорошо — лучше, плохо — хуже, легко — легче, громко — громче, долго — дольше, высоко — выше, низко — ниже, жарко — жарче, дорого — дороже. — DLI, Lesson 82. From Всеволод Гаршин, «Attalea princeps».
exercises.context: The comparative degree of Russian adjectives is formed by adding "-ее" (sometimes shortened to "-ей") to the stem of the adjective: новый — новее; красивый — красивее.

exercises.q: Тогда она вся горела, красные отблески ___ (играть / сыграть) и переливались, точно в огромном, мелко отшлифованном драгоценном камне.
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Всеволод Гаршин, «Attalea princeps».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.q: Мы не можем ___ (расти / вырасти) на такой сухой и дрянной почве, как какие-нибудь кактусы.
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Всеволод Гаршин, «Attalea princeps».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.q: Мой ствол твёрд и крепок: ___ (опираться / опереться) на него, ползи по мне.
exercises.why: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42. From Всеволод Гаршин, «Attalea princeps».
exercises.context: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42.

exercises.q: Посмотрите на меня: мне дают очень мало влаги, а я всё-таки ___ (свежий) и сочен.
exercises.why: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57. From Всеволод Гаршин, «Attalea princeps».
exercises.context: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57.

exercises.q: Мы росли бы вместе и вместе вышли бы на ___ (свобода).
exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Всеволод Гаршин, «Attalea princeps».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: Один из них ударил в ___ (шляпа) директора, выходившего из оранжереи.
exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Всеволод Гаршин, «Attalea princeps».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: Тогда она вся горела, красные отблески играли и ___ (переливаться), точно в огромном, мелко отшлифованном драгоценном камне.
exercises.why: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI, Lesson 36. From Всеволод Гаршин, «Attalea princeps».
exercises.context: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI,…

exercises.q: Меня ___ (удивлять) ваши слова, соседушка, — сказал пузатый кактус.
exercises.why: The letter с in the infinitive form писать is replaced by the letter ш in all forms of the present tense. The letter в is inserted in all present tense forms of the verb жить. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 16–18.  ·  «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Всеволод Гаршин, «Attalea princeps».
exercises.context: The letter с in the infinitive form писать is replaced by the letter ш in all forms of the present tense.

exercises.context: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37.
